cardText: Data structures and algorithms, explained simply
descriptionText: Data Structures and Algorithms is the part of programming that decides whether your code handles ten records or ten million. Learn Big O notation, arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, trees, heaps and graphs, then the techniques that solve real problems with them: two pointers, sliding windows, recursion, sorting, searching, greedy choices and dynamic programming. Every idea is explained in plain language and shown as runnable C# code.
